name: mob-spawner-spawn
comment: WP-1.8 TileEntityMobSpawner spawn attempts: tick/mob-spawner-delay run past the count-down. From t=20 every tick makes four attempts: EntityList.createEntityInWorld("Pig") (an EntityPig: an entity id and EntityLiving's Math.random draws), getEntitiesWithinAABB, the placement draws (two nextDouble pairs, nextInt(3), nextFloat yaw), getCanSpawnHere (an animal needs grass: false on stone), so nothing joins and delay stays 0. rng_state and entity_state every tick. Needs the EntityPig constructor (WP-2.3) in the port.
